_about: Acceptance test suite for the build generator (tools/benchmark.py). 'authors': real builds in the library (id prefix); the generator gets the author's items (--gear-from) and must rebuild tree, gems, auras and config - compared with the author's own build by the generator's score. 'template': fixed skill / ascendancy / archetype runs on template gear - checked against the playable floors and against the previous version (no regression). Builds whose main skill PoB models poorly (phantasms, Animate Guardian) are left out of 'authors'.

floors._about: Playable floors for a level 95 mapping build (from the 15 real builds, 2026-11-26: most have 3-6k life+ES, 10k+ smallest max hit, capped elemental resistances).
